item_short_desc: Rothco’s ANSI Rated Tactical Goggles offer superior protection and durability, making them an essential accessory for tactical professionals, public safety personnel, bikers, and more. The goggles feature 2.2mm thick anti-scratch polycarbonate lenses that provide unbeatable impact resistance, ensuring long-lasting performance in challenging environments. With UV 400 protection, these goggles shield your eyes from harmful ultraviolet rays, keeping you safe during outdoor activities.
description: Rothco’s ANSI Rated Tactical Goggles offer superior protection and durability, making them an essential accessory for tactical professionals, public safety personnel, bikers, and more. The goggles feature 2.2mm thick anti-scratch polycarbonate lenses that provide unbeatable impact resistance, ensuring long-lasting performance in challenging environments. With UV 400 protection, these goggles shield your eyes from harmful ultraviolet rays, keeping you safe during outdoor activities. The adjustable elastic strap allows for a customizable fit, ensuring comfort during extended wear. These goggles meet the ANSI-Z87-1 safety glasses standard, guaranteeing high-quality protection and reliability. Whether you're in a tactical situation or enjoying outdoor adventures, Rothco’s ANSI Rated Tactical Goggles are designed to provide the ultimate eye protection.
